# Hardy Wu — hardywu.com

> Hardy Wu is a young maker. hardywu.com has his free browser games, the BookKeep bookkeeping app, and a small shop of 3D-printed products he prints to order. AI agents are welcome to browse and to buy on behalf of a person.

## Shop (AI agents can order here)
- Catalogue (JSON): https://play.hardywu.com/api/products
- Universal Commerce Protocol (ucp.dev): profile https://hardywu.com/.well-known/ucp · REST https://play.hardywu.com/ucp · MCP (JSON-RPC tools) https://play.hardywu.com/ucp/mcp
- Flow for agents: search_catalog → create_cart / update_cart (add, change, remove) → create_checkout with buyer + US address → send the buyer to continue_url to APPROVE → poll get_checkout until completed. Nothing is ordered without the buyer's approval.
- Simpler order API (OpenAPI): https://play.hardywu.com/openapi.json — POST https://play.hardywu.com/api/agent/order
- Human storefront: https://shop.hardywu.com (asks for a name and email first)
- Payment: by card at checkout on shop.hardywu.com (Stripe); for orders placed through this API, Hardy emails the buyer to arrange payment. Free shipping within the US, US only. Contact barbaratao@gmail.com.

## Products
- Blue Crab Gauge — 13.99 USD: Keeper or throw-back in one second: a gauge that is exactly 5 inches point to point. Lay it across the crab’s back; if both side spikes reach the points, it’s a keeper. (colours: Purple, White, Black, Blue, Orange, Red, Transparent (clear)) → https://shop.hardywu.com/products/crab-gauge
- Customizable Lunchbox — 35.99 USD: A hinged lunchbox with your child’s picture and name printed into the lid in up to 4 colours. Pick the box colour, design it free, and pay only when you print. (colours: Purple, White, Black, Blue, Orange, Red, Transparent (clear)) → https://shop.hardywu.com/products/customizable-lunchbox
- Dual Ruler — 3.50 USD: Two rulers in one: centimetres on one edge, inches on the other, with every mark cut into the plastic so it never rubs off. (colours: Purple, White, Black, Blue, Orange, Red, Transparent (clear)) → https://shop.hardywu.com/products/dual-ruler
